title: The Answer Was Canberra
subject: falling for the captain of the rival team at a Tuesday pub quiz
caption: Jazz-pop in the bossa nova songbook style. Nylon-string guitar playing bossa nova comping on major sevenths and ninths; an upright bass playing the bossa two-feel on root and fifth; a jazz kit playing the bossa pattern, cross-stick clicks on the rim and soft brushed eighths on the snare; celesta doubling the vocal melody in the choruses; a small string section with a solo cello answering each line in the second verse. Warm, close and acoustic, the voice and guitar forward with gentle room ambience. Female voice, a low velvety alto with Great American Songbook phrasing and light vibrato, wry and unhurried. 128 BPM, B-flat major. Wry, smitten, losing on purpose. No electric guitar, no programmed drums, no swing ride pattern, no pop belting, no autotune, no fusion soloing.
lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and brushes]

[Verse 1]
Tuesdays at the Fox and Anchor, round four is geography
My team is three librarians and Dave, who knows the flags
Their captain wears a cardigan and writes the answers in pencil
And he looks up from the sheet each time I laugh too loud

[Chorus]
The answer was Canberra
I wrote down Sydney, I was watching his hands
We lost by a single point to a man in a cardigan
And I would lose that point again

[Verse 2]
Dave says I've gone soft, I say Dave, you do the flags
I can't help it if the man knows every river in Peru
At the break he brings our table a bowl of chips we didn't order
And mouths "Sydney?" across the room, and I have to look away

[Chorus]
The answer was Canberra
I wrote down Sydney, I was watching his hands
Next Tuesday Dave is making me sit facing the wall
I'll turn around by round two

[Bridge - strings swell, solo cello answers each line]
I know the Danube runs through four capitals
I know the deepest lake is in Siberia
Ask me where he's sitting and I'll get it every time
Ask me anything else and I'm gone

[Outro - cello and celesta, brushes stop]
He left his pencil on our table
I'm giving it back in round four
